paper.code_scope: Repository describes both HiDe-Prompt and a generalized successor; this port targets the pinned CIFAR supervised HiDe-Prompt launcher.

launcher_over_config.ca_epochs_effective_argument: crct_epochs=30 (ca_epochs exists but neither engine reads it)
launcher_over_config.actual_argparse_verification: Loaded config only with stdlib argparse/importlib: duplicate --weight-decay(default0.0) and --weight_decay(default0.0005) share a destination; the first default is the actual resolved value.
launcher_over_config.larger_prompt_lr: Enabled; classifier LR is 0.1 of prompt LR starting on task 1
launcher_over_config.lr_scaling: unscale_lr=True still multiplies nominal training LR by batch_size/256. TII also scales ca_lr; prompted trainer leaves ca_lr unscaled.

module_mapping.behavior: task-indexed prefix pool, copy previous slot, inherited prompt mixture, source-compatible layout
frozen ViT with explicit prefix K/V; original residual MLP [2], prompted branch identity MLP, fc_only classifiers
both uninstructed/instructed current-class centroid means and population variances
sampled Gaussian classifier alignment and unnormalized dot-product CE regularizer
Mammoth meta_begin_task/meta_observe/meta_end_task with explicit TII/prompt phases and task-end statistics/CA

required_runtime_adaptations.disposition: Use local feature tensors when no distributed process group is initialized; future matched reference needs the same one-process adaptation.

required_runtime_adaptations.issue: Unconditional model.module in task-end prefix momentum
required_runtime_adaptations.disposition: Use the unwrapped model in a single-GPU port; preserve the source arithmetic.
Port model APIs to existing timm0.9.8; torch.arange gives the identical inclusive 0..N-1 targets.

required_runtime_adaptations.issue: Implicit pretrained aliases and dataset download=True
required_runtime_adaptations.disposition: Reuse the pinned local AugReg NPZ and existing shared CIFAR data; future runner must fail rather than fetch unexpectedly.
Keep 10 dataset tasks/10 classes per task and stop after two; never set author num_tasks=2 for this check.

preserved_source_quirks.issue: Prefix reshape without permuting dual/batch dimensions
preserved_source_quirks.alternative: optional use_permute_fix correction is a separate ablation, not silently substituted

preserved_source_quirks.issue: Multi-centroid KMeans uses no explicit n_init or random_state
preserved_source_quirks.disposition: Native explicitly pins init=k-means++, algorithm=lloyd, n_init=10 and random_state=(seed+class_id)%2**32. These are reproducibility adaptations to implicit/version-dependent source choices; the independent reference must match them.

preserved_source_quirks.issue: CA epoch draws all seen class/centroid distributions but optimizes only old_class_count minibatches
preserved_source_quirks.disposition: Preserve sampled counts and iteration cap in a source-compatible check, expose both counts for cost accounting

preserved_source_quirks.issue: CA has no work on the first task
preserved_source_quirks.disposition: Mark task-1 alignment not_applicable, record full current-class statistics cost; measure task2 separately if alignment efficiency is a goal

preprocessing.source_train: RandomResizedCrop224 bicubic defaultscale(.08,1), ratio(.75,4/3), HFlip, brightness ColorJitter63/255, ToTensor, CIFAR mean/std
preprocessing.source_eval_and_statistics: Resize256 bicubic, CenterCrop224, ToTensor, same CIFAR mean/std
preprocessing.source_unused_values: Local scale(.05,1) and ratio variables are never passed to RandomResizedCrop
preprocessing.efficiency_override: Existing ease config with its identity normalization and different crop/jitter; compare same raw dataset and mark the separate preprocessing track.

orchestration.source: All TII tasks are trained first in a separate launch; prompted stage reloads the corresponding per-task TII checkpoint
orchestration.native: Interleave per-task TII, statistics/CA, prompt, statistics/CA inside Mammoth task lifecycle
orchestration.future_reference_requirement: Verify no future-data consumption and explicitly align phase RNG/checkpoint schedules; a global seed alone does not make the two launch orders equivalent.
orchestration.statistics_order: Both branches use per-class DataLoaderSubset BEFORE forward. Native uses stable current-task index order, shuffle=False/drop_last=False; future reference must mirror raw-index ordering and class batch boundaries rather than author RandomSampler. Legacy prefix layout makes mixed-class-forward-then-grouping incorrect.

paper_script_differences: Paper Appendix C reports alpha0.1, batch128 and CIFAR20 prompt epochs; pinned supervised CIFAR launcher uses momentum0.01, per-devicebatch24, prompt50. This port follows the pinned launcher rather than silently combining both recipes.
Paper Sup-21K experiment and README checkpoint selection differ from user-selected AugReg IN21K->IN1K local Base checkpoint. Native/reference both use the latter; no paper-number reproduction claim.
Paper reports random task splits; accepted implementation check uses fixed 0..99 class order/seed1993.

dependency_versions.native_policy: Use the installed shared environment and explicitly record all resolved versions in future runs; preparation does not install or sync dependencies.

source_acquisition.kind: Public source-code git clone for read-only audit

native_integration_review.review_type: Read-only independent source/lifecycle audit; no CL experiment
verified: TII pre_logits are raw CLS features before its residual MLP
Prompt statistics use finalized prompt with train=True and prompt_momentum=0, matching source collection
Each native task completes TII statistics/alignment before entering prompt epochs
TII alignment LR scales batch/256, prompt alignment LR remains nominal
Task routing masks unseen TII classes and maps inferred class to task without evaluation task oracle
Checkpoint state preserves the next Mammoth current_task counter and last network active_task separately
Dataset defaults allow explicit common-pilot ease preprocessing override

corrected_findings.finding: Prompt StepLR source steps after epoch training
corrected_findings.policy: First decay is USED at zero-based local epoch31 (32nd prompt epoch), not local epoch30; native schedule preserves this ordering.

corrected_findings.finding: Legacy prefix reshaping makes prompted feature extraction depend on batch layout
corrected_findings.policy: Form class-specific subsets before forward for both statistics branches; stable class sample index order and drop_last=False must be matched by future reference.

native_integration_review.pending_empirical_validation: Matched first-two-task accuracy/structure and runtime logging are not executed in this stage.
